annotations.title: Search hotels and prices on Google Hotels

description: Hotels for a city or place from Google Hotels for your dates: name, hotel class, rating and review count, nightly and total price with and without taxes, the deal versus the usual price, check-in and check-out times and coordinates. Filter by stars and nightly price. Useful for travel price research and rate comparison. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/google-hotels on your Apify account (about $0.002 per hotel; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

check_in.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for Google's default dates.

country.description: Country code that sets the currency and region, e.g. "us".

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

language.description: Language code for names and texts, e.g. "en".

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

max_nightly_price.description: Highest nightly price to keep, in USD.

min_stars.description: Lowest hotel class to keep, e.g. 4.

more_results.description: Page through more hotels per place.

name: search_google_hotels

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search hotels and prices on Google Hotels
